title: Kestrel and the Crown
author: J. M. Eastwick
blurb: Lena Ashgrove, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
